# Vendored from Bot Crossing

Source: https://github.com/Station-Sciences/bot-crossing (commit in `UPSTREAM-COMMIT`)

| --- | --- | --- |
| `model.js` | Helmet, visor and screen geometry | MIT, © Jarren Rocks (see `LICENSE`) |
| `faces.js` | The face-expression atlas | MIT, © Jarren Rocks |
| `tiltshift.js` | Depth-based tilt-shift pass | MIT, © Jarren Rocks |
| `occlusion.js` | Contact-shading (ambient occlusion) pass | MIT, © Jarren Rocks |
| `crew.glb` | Bot body + animations, from KayKit Character Animations by Kay Lousberg | CC0 1.0 (see `ASSET-CREDITS.md`) |

The files are copied unchanged. `../../bots.js` puts them together for MOH World.

Per the upstream `TRADEMARKS.md`: the name "Bot Crossing" is not ours to use, and the bot must not
be used as MOH World's logo, icon or mascot. Character designs Bot Crossing publishes after
16 September 2026 are not MIT; only what was already in the repository at the commit above is.
